When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free-to-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day.

But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. * Develop innovative projects and hone cutting-edge skills in Data Cloud technologies, Data Science models, Data storytelling, and AI.
* Other duties as assigned

* 3+ years of experience in data analytics, sales analysis, consulting, statistics, or a related field
* Experience with data extraction and manipulation tools and Data Mining tools
* Experience creating data visualization
* Online gaming experience preferred

**Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification**

* Master's Degree preferred or Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience

* Excellent knowledge of statistical analysis
* Ability to extract data by writing your own SQL queries
* Experience using Tableau or similar BI tools
* Experience using Google Analytics preferred
* Programming for data analysis (R or Python) preferred
* Ability to translate complex data into stories for diverse stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Able to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent time and project management skills

Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Data Science & Machine Vision Engineer to build an intelligence layer for global manufacturing. In this hands-on, supplier-facing role, you will integrate factory images, deploy ML models, equipment signals, MES data, test results, and material genealogy into reliable production capabilities.You will deploy machine-vision and machine-learning solutions to enhance inspection, yield, process control, root-cause analysis, and traceability across contract manufacturers and suppliers. This role suits an engineer capable of working across factory floors, Python notebooks, and production data pipelines to deliver practical, robust analytics.

### **What You Will Do:**

* Build manufacturing data foundations
* Architect and integrate end-to-end manufacturing data systems (MES, testers, cloud) across the supplier network to capture accurate production data.
* Standardize data models and improve traceability to ensure data integrity from raw components through to final product shipment.
* Establish robust data-quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring frameworks to drive reliable operational decision-making.
* Develop machine-vision systems for the factory
* Identify and implement high-value machine vision and image-based inspection opportunities across factory operations.
* Design and deploy end-to-end vision systems, covering hardware specifications (optics, cameras, lighting) and the development of robust classical and deep-learning algorithms.
* Establish data-labeling workflows and model validation frameworks to translate vision insights into actionable manufacturing decisions that optimize yield and quality.
* Automate manufacturing analysis
* Build and deploy automated analysis engines and ML/Vision models to detect process drift, defects, and anomalies directly in the production environment.
* Implement automated dashboards and alerts, correlating images with process parameters and test data to accelerate root-cause analysis and prevent yield loss.
* Develop reusable analytics libraries and tools to scale data-driven insights across Oura’s manufacturing programs and partner network.
* Explore digital-twin and simulation approaches to model manufacturing scenarios, line capacity, and process flows to optimize production before hardware availability.
* Drive deployment and strategy
* Lead the technical execution of data, machine-vision, and analytics workstreams through all NPI phases, from EVT and DVT to mass production and sustaining.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contract manufacturers, and equipment vendors to define technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and robust deployment/maintenance standards for production systems.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities in industrial AI, vision, and connected manufacturing to address production pain points and optimize quality, yield, and cycle time.
* Define and communicate the long-term manufacturing intelligence roadmap, establishing reusable data/vision standards and effectively influencing leadership and stakeholders on technical investments.

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

### **What you'll bring**

* 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing software, industrial data science, machine vision, automation, test engineering, supplier development, or an equivalent combination of experience.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, robotics, data science, or a related field.
* Experience deploying software, analytics, or machine-learning solutions in a factory, lab, warehouse, or other production environment.
* Strong Python programming skills and experience with data-processing and machine-learning libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Experience with computer vision and image-processing techniques, such as OpenCV, image classification, object detection, segmentation, OCR/OCV, anomaly detection, or metrology.
* Understanding of MES, manufacturing test systems, equipment interfaces, PLC or industrial-control data, and unit-level traceability concepts.

* Demonstrated ability to work directly with contract manufacturers, suppliers, equipment vendors, and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to manufacturing sites in Asia and other supplier locations.

### **Nice to have:**

Job Title: Lab Technician

**Mesquite Mine**

Come build your career at **Mesquite** — Equinox Gold's first-ever operating mine and a proud cornerstone of our story since 2018. Nestled in the sunny desert of Imperial County, California, this open-pit gold mine has been running strong since 1986 and has produced over five million ounces of gold and counting. With production expected to continue for years to come, Mesquite offers the stability of a proven operation alongside real opportunities to grow, learn, and make your mark.

**Equinox Gold** is a growth-focused gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, operating a diversified portfolio of high-quality, long-life mines in Canada, Mexico, Nicaragua and United States. Guided by our core values of **integrity** , **excellence** , **accountability** , and **teamwork** , we foster a safe, inclusive, and rewarding workplace where a talented, experienced team works together to deliver reliable operations, responsible mining, and long-term value to its shareholders and host communities.

**Job Summary:**

Lab Technician should be proficient in the Sample Prep, Wet Lab and Fire Assay duties, such as Atomic Absorption analysis on the Mine Samples, perform all analysis’ in the Wet Lab area, including pH, Cyanide titrations, LECO analysis, Lime testing, making calibration standards, performing QA/QC tests, knowledge of and proficient with Fire Assay Lab procedures. Demonstrate competency in LIMS with minimal guidance.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Oversee the safe and efficient operation of the assay and metallurgical laboratory

* Understands and shares the hazards and precautions associated with the chemicals used in the Lab (Acids, Bases, Cyanide, rhodanine, and LECO fluxes).

* Ability to identify safety hazards, always wear and use proper PPE.

* Follows safety instructions and job-related guidelines.

* Receive, assay and report the Hot cyanide assays, LECO assays, and other tests performed in the Lab.

* Perform various QA/QC procedures to ensure that the results from the Wet Lab are consistent and correct.

* Properly maintain the AA, LECO, keep the area clean and orderly to minimize opportunity for errors.

* Help in other areas of the Laboratory when required or directed.

* Perform mandatory pre-shift inspections in the Lab.

* Proficient in Sample Prep duties such as receiving, collecting and inspecting incoming samples, performing Sieve analysis, and performing minor maintenance on sample prep equipment, etc.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:**

* 1 year working in a Lab position with experience Wet and Fire Lab duties, preferred but not required
* Perform mathematical calculations, problem solving and analytical ability necessary
* Attention to detail, follow directions, read, write legibly and complete forms accurately

Certifications: None Required.

Education: High School Diploma or equivalent.

**Working Conditions:**  
Work is performed at an active mine site that may include open pit mining, processing facilities, leach pads, maintenance areas, and office environments. Employees may be exposed to extreme weather conditions associated with a desert climate, including high heat, cold temperatures, wind, dust, and occasional precipitation or flash flooding. Depending on the role, work areas may involve proximity to large mobile equipment, moving mechanical parts, blasting activities, noise, vibration, diesel exhaust fumes, chemicals, fuels, oils, airborne particles, or other industrial hazards typical of mining operations. Outdoor work on uneven or rough terrain is common for many roles. Employees may encounter desert wildlife and native plant life. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn as determined by job duties, task hazards, and work location. PPE includes, but is not limited to, hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety footwear, and other PPE as determined by job task and location.

**Physical Demands:**  
Manual dexterity; handling and grasping; fingering and fine motor skills; speaking clearly; hearing in speech, radio, and environmental ranges; seeing, reading, and comprehension; near and distant vision; depth perception. While performing job responsibilities, employees must be able to communicate effectively and maintain situational awareness in an active mining environment. Physical activities may include standing, walking, sitting, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, crouching, or working on uneven surfaces. Use of hands and fingers to operate tools, equipment, controls, or computer systems is required. Specific physical demand requirements will be provided during the interview process. Employees may be required to work while wearing the required PPE, including respiratory and hearing protection. These requirements are representative, but not all‑inclusive, of the knowledge, skill, and ability required of the employee.

The salary range for this position is from $22.63 to $24.83.

* Job Description Job Summary  
  Quality Control Technician is responsible for inspecting materials being produced, preparing and testing samples, interpreting and reporting results, and conducting routine and special laboratory testing to ensure conformance with American Society for Testing and Materials(ASTM) and VMC standards on all materials. Examines causes of poor product quality, researches causes of complaints and implements corrective action. Acts as a source of knowledge to operations personnel with the ability to advise and recommend changes.  
    
  Essential Functions  
  • Samples and conducts testing on aggregates conforming to the appropriate standard test methods.  
  • Field and laboratory testing of complete product line to insure Quality Control of products at the point of production, shipping and arrival upon the jobsite.  
  • Test methods include but are not limited to American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM), American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) and Department of Transportation (DOT).  
  • Individual must perform testing proficiently and accurately.  
  • Communicates test results in a timely manner to supervisor and properly documents in data base.  
  • Troubleshoot problems and review basic product specifications.  
  • Visually inspects stockpiles, materials sources, and truck loads at plant sites.  
  • Monitors daily the construction of the stockpile to ensure that segregation and contamination is kept to a minimum or eliminated. Notifies management immediately if contamination is identified.  
  • Conducts testing and assists in plant calibrations to insure the proper quality of the product.  
  • Completes all required reports in a timely and accurate manner. Maintains appropriate hard copy files.  
  • Periodically inspects, calibrates and maintains testing equipment.  
  • Ensures housekeeping standards are maintained in and around the lab.  
  • Develops and maintains relationships with state/county/city inspectors and customers to allow for proper and timely communication of test results and speedy resolution of any product quality issues or concerns.  
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Customer Focus - Builds positive customer relationships and gains trust and respect, prioritizing their needs and using feedback to improve products and services.  
  • Communication - Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, while actively listening and adapting the message to the audience.  
  • Team Player - Works cooperatively and effectively with team members to achieve shared goals, willingly assisting others and fostering a positive and productive team environment.  
  • Planning and Scheduling - Effective planning of repair procedures, scheduling work considering resource availability, and maintaining necessary inventory.  
  • Problem Solving - Identify, analyze, and resolve work-related issues efficiently and effectively using practical knowledge, experience, and hands-on skills. Finds practical solutions, implements fixes, and adapts to unexpected challenges.  
  • Quality Control - Ensure that products, services, or processes meet quality standards by systematically inspecting and testing them to identify defects and make necessary improvements.

Experience

• ACI Concrete Laboratory Technician Level I

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
